headline: LeviLauncher v1.7.1
summary: Includes the v1.7.0 launcher and in-game mod menu redesign, Google Play downloads, lip-compatible package management, and faster startup, plus fixes for the latest Minecraft Beta and network navigation crashes in v1.7.1.

items.text: Fixed a crash when switching from Downloads to Launch while Google Play was slow or unreachable.
Fixed a launch crash affecting the latest Minecraft Beta.
Download Minecraft directly from Google Play by signing in with a Google account that owns the game. (#451)
Added a lip-compatible package manager and a Package Management tab that follows the Windows launcher layout. (#443)
Added a creator notice and refreshed its dialog.
Refreshed the launcher interface to match LeviLauncher for Windows, with a centered top navigation bar that adapts to screen width and stacked pages by default. (#454, #456)
Improved the home layout and instance icons. The home screen now shows External Mods after LeviMC Mods. (#448)
Redesigned Settings, Downloads, Mods, Instances, Content Management, and About.
Redesigned the News and account screens, refined mod actions, and improved the world tools.
Redesigned the in-game mod menu and updated its themes.
Sped up the splash screen and reduced runtime overhead in the launcher and mod menu.
Completed translations for the refreshed launcher interface.
Applied the GitHub proxy to external mods and aligned the proxy presets with the Windows launcher. The default is now gh-proxy.org. (#447, #449)
Added an end-to-end launch test with a placeholder game and made the package test handle early process exits.
Fixed page titles going out of view and adjusted the appearance options to fit. Downloads now explains why the list is empty.
Fixed CurseForge access in local debug builds by using the embedded API key. (#455)
Updated project links after the repository was renamed to LeviLauncher-Android. (#445)
